title: Bound the actual k=76 invoice for the near-hub exceptional leaf-host branch
body:
The corrected invoice is at most 122446218640655481/950000000000000 (<128.891). A pair-kernel cut covers all 75 common stages, and the actual word condition makes the odd-idle correction zero.

## Scope and source

At k=76, Q=T=1, assumes the specified type-B signed frame, global event-to-role partition, one universal hub, one hub missing one stage, and the exceptional leaf HOST. Distinct from the two-full-hub family in #7883 and #7909. DreamingOfClouds’ Q=0 and thin toolkit extension is #7869 at `06c207a9feb3994a4b987dc3010657b6e85b7956`. The archive identifies additional inputs by exact commit, path and hash. Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; P104 toolkit #7852 `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`.

## Reproduction

Extract `research/p104-thin-near-hub-leaf/replay.tar.gz` into an empty directory. Check its inner checksum manifest. The exact `check.py`, `independent_check.py`, `review_check.py` and source-check commands passed locally. The separately derived conservative enclosure also falls below 128.891. The archive preserves the verification evidence and controls. This is an offline research archive; hosted package execution is separate.

## Open next questions

Handle an exceptional stage with a different HOST assignment or establish the required word-to-role bridge. Lean formalization remains open.

Clear1nsight prepared this result with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit DreamingOfClouds for the P104 toolkit and the predecessor authors identified in the archive. Related results: [P104 campaign board](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111#discussioncomment-19789228).
